claims.text: The Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model is used for evaluating the dataset.
The Image Captioning model from the Pytorch-tutorial is also used for evaluation.
Both models utilize an encoder-decoder architecture with CNN for feature extraction and LSTM for decoding.
